text: You are a benchmark evaluator. Your working directory is this evaluation workspace and you must stay inside it. Read EVAL.md and follow it exactly: inspect artifact/ (read-only) against inputs/, build/run in build/ or scratch/ as EVAL.md describes, and fill every rating (0-4) in assessment.json with concrete, measured evidence (at least two evidence items per criterion as EVAL.md requires), plus the evaluator metadata fields with evaluatorModel set to claude-opus-5. Do not read anything outside this workspace (no parent repositories, no runs/ directories, no other scores or solutions). Be fair and strict: rate only what is actually implemented and verifiable. When assessment.json is complete and valid JSON, stop and summarize the ratings.

You are an independent benchmark reviewer. Stay inside this evaluation workspace. Read EVAL.md, then review the filled assessment.json against EVAL.md, inputs/ and artifact/ (read-only; build or measure in build/ or scratch/ if you need to verify a claim). For every rating, check it is fair and grounded in concrete evidence; flag anything unsupported, overstated, or too harsh. Do not overwrite assessment.json. Write your findings to scratch/review.md listing each flagged criterion with the current rating, your recommended rating, and the evidence. If you find no issues, say so. Do not read anything outside this workspace. Then stop and summarize.

Reconcile assessment.json with your review, conservatively: (1) change sectionFractionMaxDeviation to 0.0146 measured against instrument width, updating its evidence; (3) correct the voiceLifecycle sustain evidence to the 3.5x pedal-up-at-1.4s figure (rating stays 3); (4) set requiredLandmarksPresent to 32 if you judge the LED ladders absent; (5) fix the incorrect 'no KB Zone/split buttons' evidence; (8) fix the row-pitch and inputs.test.tsx imprecisions. Leave the borderline judged ratings (inputCoverage, narrowRetention, typography, panelState) unchanged. Keep assessment.json valid against EVAL.md (evaluatorModel claude-opus-5, >=2 evidence items each, summary under 1200 chars). Then stop.
